C0767.title: National Public Data breach: What you need to know
C0767.summary: Microsoft Support states that background check and fraud prevention service National Public Data experienced a significant data breach in early 2024. The company said a malicious actor accessed its systems in December 2023 and leaked sensitive data to the dark web from April through summer 2024, allegedly affecting up to 2.9 billion records and 170 million people.
